origin.trigger: J, 2026-08-13 ~14:15 ET, unprompted, while a same-day rising support sat 0.03 from the close: 'should we be drawing or theorizing on this trend line break as we approach the key level'.
origin.why_it_is_a_real_question: The existing break dataset is UNCONDITIONAL. It answers 'do trendline breaks pay?' (no) and has never been sliced on whether the break happened AT a key level. J's question is exactly that confluence cohort, and it is not in any artifact in this repo.

baseline_already_measured_do_not_re_deri.scope: 380 trading days 2025-01-02..2026-07-13, 78,191 qualifying lines, 52,833 breaks, min_respect_beyond_anchors_gate=2, RTH 09:30-15:55
baseline_already_measured_do_not_re_deri.reading: MAE exceeds MFE at EVERY horizon in BOTH directions, and the ratio decays with time (0.71 -> 0.64 -> 0.59 on wick_support). Roughly half of all breaks retest within 10 bars. Unconditionally, the break is not the trade.

the_hypothesis: A trendline break whose break price sits inside a key-level zone behaves DIFFERENTLY from the unconditional break population -- specifically, that confluence raises the MFE/MAE ratio relative to the same-family baseline.
why_the_prior_is_against_it: This repo has repeatedly found that proximity gates ANTI-correlate with breakout setups (C20: 'gate direction must match setup structure'). A break is a breakout-class event; a level is a mean-reversion-class attractor. The mechanism could plausibly run either way, and the honest expectation is NO effect. A large positive effect should be treated as an implementation error first (see /fable-too-good).

cohort_definition.join_key: break.line_value_at_break (the price at which the break occurred) and date_et

primary_level_set.derived_from: backtest/data/spy_5m_2025-01-01_2026-07-08.csv -- THE SAME BAR CACHE THE BREAK DATASET WAS BUILT FROM, so no new data lineage is introduced
primary_level_set.causality: INTRADAY_* levels are computed from bars STRICTLY BEFORE the break bar. A level that includes the break bar itself is look-ahead (C6) and voids the cell.

secondary_level_set.purpose: FIDELITY CHECK ONLY -- does the derived structural set agree with what the live level engine actually published on the days where both exist?
secondary_level_set.rule: NEVER pooled with the primary set, and n=18 days is reported as too small to conclude from. MEMORY_SUP_* / MEMORY_RES_* multi-day levels cannot be reconstructed outside these 18 days and are OUT OF SCOPE -- stated as a limitation, not silently omitted.

proximity_bands_preregistered.rule: ALL SIX are reported. Band width is a pre-registered sweep, never hand-picked after seeing results -- J's standing rule ('levels are ZONES not prices; band width = pre-reg A/B, never hand-picked'). Selecting the best band post hoc is the failure this list exists to prevent.
proximity_bands_preregistered.control_band: A break is 'AT a level' if min |line_value_at_break - level_price| <= band. Everything else is the NOT-AT-LEVEL cohort, which is reported alongside -- not discarded.

metrics.primary: mfe_H / mae_H ratio at H in {30, 60, 90} min, per anchor_family x kind, conditional vs unconditional.
metrics.HONESTY_CLAUSE: MFE/MAE is EXCURSION, not P&L. It applies no stop, no target, no theta, and no spread. A favourable excursion ratio is NECESSARY but nowhere near SUFFICIENT to trade -- this repo has already been burned by SPY-price edge that did not survive option economics (C3). No cell from this study may be described as profitable. The maximum output is: a cohort worth pricing on real OPRA in a SEPARATE study.

multiple_comparisons.cells: 6 bands x 4 family-kind combos x 3 horizons = 72 primary cells
multiple_comparisons.correction: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR at q=0.10 across all 72. Uncorrected p-values are reported but never used for a verdict.
multiple_comparisons.null: Within-day permutation: shuffle the level set across dates (keeping the level COUNT and the intraday spacing distribution intact) and re-measure. A confluence effect that survives date-shuffling is a distance artifact, not confluence.

validity_gates.G1_baseline_reproduces: Re-deriving the unconditional numbers from break-dataset.jsonl must reproduce break-dataset-summary.json EXACTLY. If it does not, the summary and the raw file disagree and NOTHING downstream is interpretable.
validity_gates.G2_no_lookahead: Every INTRADAY level must be computed from bars strictly before break_bar_idx. Assert per row; a violation voids the cell rather than being footnoted.
validity_gates.G3_patch_binds: Vary-and-assert (C14): the AT-LEVEL cohort size must CHANGE monotonically with band width. If all six bands return the same n, the join did not bind and the result is meaningless.
validity_gates.G4_not_run_is_not_a_pass: Any cell with n < 30 breaks is reported NOT-RUN, never as a null result.
validity_gates.G5_read_only: analysis/, automation/state/ and all params are READ-ONLY for this study. It arms nothing.

necessary_and_not_sufficient: G1 reproduces the published baseline exactly.
The effect survives BH-FDR at q=0.10.
The effect survives the date-shuffled null.
The effect is MONOTONE or at least coherent across adjacent bands -- an effect that appears at 0.35 and vanishes at 0.20 and 0.50 is noise wearing a band.
The direction matches the stated mechanism, not just the sign that would be convenient.
what_would_make_me_recommend_anything.and_even_then: The output is a CANDIDATE COHORT for real-OPRA pricing, never an armed gate. Excursion is not P&L.

ship_rule.produces: One table of all 72 cells plus the NOT-AT-LEVEL comparison, the null result, and a one-line verdict per family.
ship_rule.provenance_stamp: The published table carries the git HEAD it was produced at and this prereg_id, so a downstream reader cannot inherit soundness sight-unseen (L293).

execution_note: The break dataset is 67MB / ~52,833 break rows. The Windows reaper kills project python > 5 min (see CLAUDE.md debugging section), so the runner MUST stream the JSONL and checkpoint, or run as an exempt long-grind task. A runner killed mid-scan that writes a partial table is the exact silent-truncation failure this repo keeps repeating.

evidence.summary: Runner was written and run (one day after freeze) per the prereg's own frozen spec; result file exists and is decisive: 0/72 cells survive BH-FDR.
evidence.numbers: Population 50,132 breaks over 376 trading days. 72 cells (6 bands x 4 family-kind x 3 horizons), all measured, none NOT-RUN. 0 of 72 survive BH-FDR q=0.10; smallest p=0.408. All validity gates G0-G5 PASS (G0 DST-frame join verified to <1 cent on 376/379 dates; G3 monotonic cohort scaling verified).
evidence.artifact_hunt_disclosed: The runner's FIRST execution reported 72/72 surviving at p=0.001 (a too-good sweep); root-caused to a NaN-permutation bug (breaks with no forward bars produced abs(nan)>=abs(nan)==False, collapsing every p-value to the floor). Fixed, guarded with a TOO_GOOD_TRIPWIRE that reads TRIPPED:false on the corrected run -- this is exactly the /fable-too-good discipline the goal's OPERATING RULES expect.
evidence.rationale: This is the second location-based entry hypothesis killed by its own pre-registered date-shuffle null in two days (companion: ENTRY-LOCATION-GATE). The naively-positive at-level effect (e.g. +26% relative MFE/MAE improvement, body_support band<=1.00 H90) reproduces 41% of the time under date-shuffling -- a distance/mid-range artifact, not confluence. C20 (proximity gates anti-correlate with breakout setups) holds again.
